about: Whirl Cut (katana.k_dh, the dodge heavy), milestone-1 task 75: Attack2H03's two-handed sweep across from the right to the left, made a full turn to the left, out of a dodge: a hop off the roll with the blade carried back behind the right hip (source frames 0-6 over 8), then the whole body spun 360 degrees to the left on the balls of the feet, skimming the floor (frames 6-21, quickening), the blade trailing round low behind, and the sweep across the front as the turn comes round (the active frames 20.5-23.5), the crouch held, then back up to the guard by the settle at 44.5. Two-handed, as the owner chose for the heavies (Oct 8): the left hand set on the grip and the blade kept clear of the body. The body drifts forward through it at a steady pace from the start (0.63 m in this rig's metres; the feet leave the ground on frame 1, so the turn carries that pace, about 1.4 m in all on the game's bodies). Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
